newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: North Korean woman defects to South Korea.
newsitem.headline: North Korean woman defects to South Korea.

text.p: A North Korean woman defected to South Korea on Thursday across the demilitarised zone bisecting the Korean peninsula, the defence ministry said.

"One North Korean citizen defected through the eastern sector of the border at about 10:20 a.m. (0120 GMT)," a ministry statement said, without giving details of how the woman slipped through one of the world's most heavily-fortified borders.
The statement said the woman was in her 20s but gave no other details. Her motives for fleeing were being investigated, it said.
Seoul is now seeking to bring a senior North Korean defector holed up in South Korea's diplomatic mission in Beijing to the South.

Talks between Beijing and Seoul resumed on Wednesday over the fate of Hwang Jang-yop, the most senior official to flee North Korea, after negotiations were stalled by the death last week of Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping. But South Korean officials reported no progress.
Hwang, ranked 24th in Pyongyang's hierarchy, sought asylum in Beijing on February 12.
